member.name: M:Kinichit.Communication.SqlServerEmailQueueStore.SchemaName
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z_a-z].
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Z_a-z] atomically at most 63 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
